_version: June 2026 — competition-intelligence-based (replaces Tarun's 2021 self-analytics which were tiny and misleading)
_source: Competitor account analysis: mavgpt (933K), cindie.zhu, katecore.ai, tenfoldmarc, ankurwarikoo (~9M), christi.steyn (~100K+), joeykidney (~500K). Data from master_brief.md June 2026 audit.
dominant_engagement_model: comment→DM CTA: comment count exceeds like count on top posts. mavgpt: 15.4K comments vs 19.1K likes (Claude+Higgsfield MCP). tenfoldmarc: 243% comment-to-like ratio ('Spy on competitors with Claude'). The CTA is working harder than the content itself.

data_science_tech.reel_formula: Revelation hook ('You can now connect Claude to [tool]') → 3-step setup → specific outcome → comment→DM CTA. mavgpt hit 19.1K likes / 15.4K comments with this exact structure. NOT tutorial voice — tool reveal voice.
data_science_tech.carousel_formula: Free AI tool / resource carousel drives saves: katecore.ai free tools carousel = 1.1K saves. cindie.zhu 'Claude as creator studio' = 17.7K likes. Numbered slides, each slide = one tool or one step. Cover slide = the outcome/collection claim.
data_science_tech.caption_model: Caption IS the product — full value verbatim. Line 1: 'Comment KEYWORD and I'll send you [deliverable] 👆'. Then: one specific claim → the FULL steps/prompts/tools as a numbered list. Not a teaser. Readers should be able to act from the caption alone. Honesty guardrail: claim only what's shown.
data_science_tech.dm_keyword_pattern: Tool name or outcome (e.g. FLOW, CLAUDE, PROMPTS, SETUP)
hot_angles_june_2026: Claude MCP integrations — connecting Claude to other tools
Spy on competitors with Claude — high comment-to-like ratio
Free AI tools resource carousel — drives massive saves
data_science_tech.format_decision_rule: Reel for engagement (comment→DM CTA model). Carousel for saves (free tool / resource format). Tutorial blog → carousel. News/opinion blog → reel.

life_self_dev.reel_formula: Text-wall thumbnail (the claim itself, declarative, bright bg, 1–3 bold lines, NOT a face thumbnail) → contrarian hook stated as fact → mechanism teaching (name WHY this keeps happening, one precise sentence) → flat instructional close (no motivational crescendo). @ankurwarikoo formula.
life_self_dev.carousel_formula: Same text-wall claim on cover slide → each slide = one mechanism/step with a named principle → final slide = the one action. Education-first, not inspiration.
life_self_dev.caption_model: Mode C (mechanism line extracted verbatim — the single most precise insight as a quote card). OR Mode B (narrative hook + mechanism, 3–5 sentences) for setup content. Mode A (essay+vulnerability, 5 short prose paragraphs) for heavy emotional topics only. Product never in caption — first pinned comment or DM keyword instead.
life_self_dev.dm_keyword_pattern: Topic keyword (e.g. BOOK, SYSTEM, DATA, FRAMEWORK)
life_self_dev.community_cta_rule: Community ask ONLY for weighty topics: grief, loss, loneliness, friendship fade. NEVER on productivity or tips content.
hot_angles_june_2026: Ancient wisdom modernized (Bhagavad Gita on X)
Contrarian on conventional wisdom (Stop following your passion)
Failure autopsy (Why most X fail — names the mechanism)
Mirror moment (If you're still doing X at 30)
life_self_dev.format_decision_rule: Reel (text-wall hook, mechanism teaching) for reach. Carousel for educational series. Heavy emotional topics → essay-as-caption reel with community CTA.

poetry_quotes.reel_formula: Face-to-camera, warm golden-hour or soft indoor light, close-up. Poem spoken as original audio. Caption = full poem verbatim (save trigger — what people screenshot and send to a partner). Zero hashtags. No explanation. @christi.steyn formula — 370K reel.
poetry_quotes.single_image_formula: One devastating line + emoji as entire caption. B&W or cinematic photograph. No explanation. People project their own story. @christi.steyn 'your home, is my arms' = 63.9K views, 8.2% like rate.
poetry_quotes.forwarding_mechanic: For relational/seasonal content: simple statement (5 words) people forward to a specific person. Timed to relational calendar (Mother's Day, Valentine's, friendship anniversaries). @joeykidney 'I am proud you are my mother' = 209K likes.
poetry_quotes.caption_model: Full poem verbatim (save trigger) OR single devastating line + emoji OR enticing hook line only. NEVER explain the poem. Author credit, nothing else. Permission close outperforms sad close.
hot_angles_june_2026: Projective surface poems (reader sees their own story)
Non-announcing poem (formatted as prose, avoids poetry-niche algorithm penalty)
Bilingual emotional depth — English precision carrying an Indian emotional register
poetry_quotes.format_decision_rule: Reel for reach (face-to-camera, poem spoken, full poem in caption). Single-image for a single devastating line. Never explain the poem.

repurposing_agent_instruction: Use niche_format_guidance for ALL format and caption decisions. Reel is the dominant primary format for all three niches in June 2026. Do NOT default to carousel as primary. The comment→DM CTA model drives comment counts above like counts. DS: caption IS the product (full verbatim value, not a teaser). Life: mechanism line is the caption (Mode C). Poetry: full poem in caption = save trigger. For carousels (DS secondary): free tool / step-by-step format drives saves.
